---
name: unit-tests-file
description: Generate and validate unit tests for a specific source file or symbol.
agent: unit-agent
argument-hint: "<file-path> [symbol-name]"

<!-- generated by unit-agent init-chat {{version}} hash={{hash}}; change .unit-agent.yml and re-run init-chat instead of editing -->
Run `{{cli}} local detect --scope files --files <file-path> [--symbols <symbol-name>] --include-covered --json`, inspect each context with `{{cli}} local show --context <fileId>`, draft tests under `{{stagingDir}}/`, and validate with `{{cli}} local validate --json`.
